name: Image Classification Basics
learningObjectives: Understand how neural networks process image features for classification
Learn the role of hidden layers in extracting meaningful patterns
Explore how softmax activation enables multi-class classification
Visualize decision boundaries in feature space
Interpret confusion matrices for multi-class problems

controls.label: Dataset
controls.tooltip: Choose a dataset with extracted image features

controls.label: Learning Rate
controls.tooltip: Controls how quickly the network learns. Higher values train faster but may be unstable.

controls.label: Epochs
controls.tooltip: Number of training iterations. More epochs allow better learning but take longer.

controls.label: Hidden Layer Size
controls.tooltip: Number of neurons in the hidden layer. More neurons increase model capacity.

controls.label: Regularization (L2)
controls.tooltip: Prevents overfitting by penalizing large weights. Higher values create simpler models.

visualizations.title: Feature Space Visualization
visualizations.description: Scatter plot showing different image classes in feature space

visualizations.title: Confusion Matrix
visualizations.description: Matrix showing classification performance across all classes
